mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session_qa_record ( record_id, session_id, sequence_no, user_question, agent_answer, agent_id, record_status, ext_info, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{recordId}, #{sessionId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{userQuestion}, #{agentAnswer}, #{agentId}, #{recordStatus}, #{extInfo}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, record_id, session_id, sequence_no, user_question, agent_answer, agent_id, record_status, ext_info, create_time, update_time FROM agent_session_qa_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT user_question FROM ( SELECT user_question, sequence_no FROM agent_session_qa_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_question IS NOT NULL AND user_question != '' ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT 10 ) t ORDER BY sequence_no ASC
